title: Bound decoded CKC media and Posekit image caches
origin: MT-044 D3 split: decoded texture caches can grow without an explicit cap while browsing many linked images.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Resume MT-047 by reading this contract, limiting edits to allowed_paths, using external CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts, and keeping validator_verdict PENDING until an official validator changes it.

scope.summary: Add deterministic size/LRU bounds for decoded image cache state used by CKC linked-media and Posekit source images, or prove a singleton cache is already bounded and document that boundary in code/tests.
base_scope: Add deterministic size/LRU bounds for decoded image cache state used by CKC linked-media and Posekit source images, or prove a singleton cache is already bounded and document that boundary in code/tests.
acceptance_criteria: CKC media image cache cannot grow unbounded as many assets are browsed.
Posekit source image cache is either explicitly bounded or proven singleton by focused tests.
Eviction preserves the currently selected image and does not show stale textures.
Cache limits are deterministic and testable without foreground UI.
risks_and_controls: Risk: eviction drops the selected media image and creates blank previews.
Risk: cache metadata grows while texture entries shrink.
verification: Code inspection confirms no unbounded map remains for decoded CKC media textures.

review_lenses: scope containment versus MT-044 tracker drift

manual_requirement: Not required unless implementation changes operator/model-facing workflow text.

handoff.note: MT-047 is ready for validator review. This is not official validation; validator_verdict remains PENDING. CKC linked-media decoded image cache is now capped by deterministic LRU, Posekit source image cache is explicitly single-slot/proven by render-path checks, selected CKC media survives cache overflow, byte replacement invalidates stale dimensions, and default CKC selection still does not issue startup media-byte fetches.
implementation_summary: Added CKC_MEDIA_IMAGE_CACHE_ENTRY_LIMIT=32 with access-counter LRU eviction inside the CKC per-asset decoded image cache.
Touched CKC cache recency on insert, cache-hit checks, and render preparation; overflow evicts oldest non-protected asset by deterministic last_access then asset-id order.
Added AtelierImageCacheDebugSnapshot plus image_cache_debug_snapshot so tests can verify CKC cache count and Posekit singleton state without foreground UI.
Kept Posekit source image as a one-slot cache and moved source-ref sync before source render preparation to avoid a stale one-frame source texture after ref changes.

Narrowed same-ref CKC refetch so it does not break the no-startup-fetch invariant; refetch only falls through when status indicates bytes had previously loaded/cached but the cache entry is now absent.
proof_results: ckc_media_image_cache_eviction_bounds_decoded_textures: 1 passed, 0 failed; proves Posekit render-path singleton replacement dimensions, CKC limit fill/overflow, selected image survives overflow, and CKC selected byte replacement invalidates stale dimensions.
ckc_media_viewer_default_selection_never_fetches_user_change_does: 1 passed, 0 failed; includes second-render assertion so default CKC selection still emits no startup media-byte fetch.
git diff --check exit 0 with LF-to-CRLF warnings only on the two allowed files.
post_review_resolution: Pre-review finding: CKC BTreeMap per-asset cache was the unbounded cache; Posekit was already single-slot. Resolution: CKC LRU cap added; Posekit singleton verified through render-path assertions.

Post-review finding: initial proof did not force Posekit decode/upload. Resolution: test now runs the Posekit render path and asserts source viewport dimensions 17x11 then 9x13 plus pose_source_has_texture.

Post-review finding: CKC stale texture after byte replacement was not proven. Resolution: test replaces selected CKC bytes after an existing texture and asserts dimensions change to 29x17 before overflow.

Post-review finding: same-ref cache miss could break default no-fetch invariant. Resolution: same-ref refetch only proceeds after previous loaded/cache status; regression now syncs default selection twice and passes.
Post-review finding: Posekit source-ref sync could render previous texture for one frame. Resolution: source-ref sync now runs before prepare_pose_source_render.
artifacts: ../Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-cargo-target/wp-ckc-posekit-overhaul-mt-047 was created for final proof and removed after proof; cleanup verified with Test-Path=False; removed size 7292382164 bytes.
residual_gaps: No official validator verdict yet; validator_verdict remains PENDING.

Pre-existing same-frame CKC media row-click ordering can briefly render the prior preview while selected-media state updates after the list click; this is outside the cache-bound acceptance path and should be handled by a dedicated UI render-order MT if the validator wants it closed.
